batchRequest.request: Add a date range select that filters the dashboard, and remove the products table.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, kpiBlock, chartCard, tableCard])
header = InlineHeader("Sales Dashboard", "Performance overview for the last 12 months")
kpiBlock = OverviewCardBlock([k1, k2, k3, k4], "grid")
k1 = OverviewCardItem("revenue", k1top, k1m)
k1top = IconText(k1i, "info", "m", "Total Revenue", "YTD", false, "horizontal")
k1i = Icon("circle-dollar-sign", "finance")
k1m = MetricIndicatorInline("$1.42M", "vs last year", { direction: "up", value: 12 })
k2 = OverviewCardItem("orders", k2top, k2m)
k2top = IconText(k2i, "success", "m", "Orders", "YTD", false, "horizontal")
k2i = Icon("shopping-cart", "shopping")
k2m = MetricIndicatorInline("18,240", "vs last year", { direction: "up", value: 8 })
k3 = OverviewCardItem("aov", k3top, k3m)
k3top = IconText(k3i, "warning", "m", "Avg. Order Value", "YTD", false, "horizontal")
k3i = Icon("receipt", "finance")
k3m = MetricIndicatorInline("$77.80", "vs last year", { direction: "up", value: 3 })
k4 = OverviewCardItem("conv", k4top, k4m)
k4top = IconText(k4i, "danger", "m", "Conversion Rate", "YTD", false, "horizontal")
k4i = Icon("percent", "finance")
k4m = MetricIndicatorInline("2.9%", "vs last year", { direction: "down", value: 4 })
chartCard = Card([chartHeader, lineChart])
chartHeader = CardHeader("Monthly Revenue", "Revenue in thousands of USD")
lineChart = LineChart(months, [revSeries], "natural", "Month", "Revenue ($K)")
months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
revSeries = Series("Revenue", [92, 98, 105, 110, 118, 112, 121, 127, 124, 135, 148, 170])
tableCard = Card([tableHeader, productTable])
tableHeader = CardHeader("Top Products", "Ranked by revenue")
productTable = Table([Col("Product", pNames), Col("Category", pCats), Col("Units Sold", pUnits, "number"), Col("Revenue ($)", pRev, "number")])
pNames = ["Widget Pro", "Smart Hub", "Wireless Earbuds", "Fitness Band", "Desk Lamp"]
pCats = ["Hardware", "Electronics", "Audio", "Wearables", "Home"]
pUnits = [4820, 3410, 2960, 2185, 1740]
pRev = [313300, 272800, 236800, 174800, 69600]
request: Add a date range select that filters the dashboard, and remove the products table.
